newsitem.title: UK: Flextech names Adam Singer as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Flextech names Adam Singer as chairman.

text.p: Flextech Plc, the satellite and cable television programme provider, on Friday said it had appointed Adam Singer as full time chairman.
Stanislas Yassukovich is to step down as chairman at the company's annual meeting on June 24, but will remain on the board as deputy chairman and chairman of the audit and remuneration committees.
Singer is currently president and chief operating officer of America's biggest cable television group Tele-Communications International Inc (TINTA), the majority owner of Flextech.
Singer, who has been deputy chairman of Flextech since November 1995, will remain a director of both TINTA and UK cable operator Telewest Communications Plc.
"Adam has played an integral role in Flextech's success and initiated the BBC/Flextech joint venture," Flextech group chief executive Roger Luard said in a statement.

Last September, Flextech and BBC Worldwide, the BBC's BBC.CN commercial arm, agreed to form a joint venture to create a series of mainly digital subscription television channels in Britain, the Channel Islands, the Isle of Man and the Irish Republic.
In March, the BBC said it was linking up with Flextech to offer up to eight new pay television channels.
